description: If you are tired of your old dining chairs and want to try a new look of the dining room with an inexpensive way, try our BTSKY stretchy chair covers.

The stretchy washable dining chair slipcovers are made of durable fabric polyester which can withstand heavy use, they are stretchy and simple enough to slip on/off. You can just put on/off in seconds, no tools required.  They will transform existing dark chairs and make better with the house, no longer see the stained black dining seats.  If your chair size meets the following demands, our slipcovers will fit: Back Height: 17.7-23.6inch (45-60cm) Seat Length:15.7-19.7inch (40-50cm) Seat Width:15.7-19.7inch (40-50cm)
Material: Made from a blend of polyester and spandex fabric; Excellent elasticity, feel smooth, durable.
Back Height: 17.7-23.6inch (45-60cm) Seat Length: 15.7-19.7inch (40-50cm) Seat Width: 15.7-19.7inch (40-50cm) can be used to Most Person's Chair
